description: July 17 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 3, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 17 birthday falls in Cancer, in the third decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 17 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Can a dreamer also be a manager? July 17th suggests so. The ambitious number 8 joins Cancer twenty-four degrees along, in the Neptune decan of imagination. This birthday is traditionally associated with creative enterprise: running a gallery, a kitchen, a charity, a studio. Vision supplies the purpose; eight supplies the spreadsheet; Cancer supplies the loyalty to the team.

On July 17 the Sun usually sits at about 24° Cancer, in the third decan, where Neptune is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, shapes the final decan of Cancer, from about July 13 to July 22. Here the sign's sensitivity widens into something more porous and imaginative. Those born in this stretch are often described as dreamy, compassionate and highly attuned to atmosphere, art and music. They may absorb other people's feelings without noticing where their own end. Neptune can bring a gift for healing spaces, storytelling and quiet kindness, along with a tendency to retreat when life gets loud. Clear boundaries, gently held, tend to protect that compassion rather than limit it.

sections.heading: July 17 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 17th, you have the compound 1 + 7 = 8 as your birthday number. The 1 brings ambition and drive, the 7 brings analysis and inner reflection, and together they feed the 8's practical authority. People born on this day are often described as strategic and independent, with good judgement about money, systems and long-term plans. They tend to think before they act, then act decisively. Read as a secondary number, the 17 is traditionally associated with quiet confidence and with achievement that comes from combining a clear vision with patient attention to detail.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 17 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on July 17: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 17 is the 198th day of the year (199th in a leap year). By July 23, 6 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 17, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 17 include Angela Merkel (1954), Donald Sutherland (1935) and James Cagney (1899).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 17?
faq.answer: July 17 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 17?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 17 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 17th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 17?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 17 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 17?
faq.answer: July 17 is also the birthday of Angela Merkel (1954), Donald Sutherland (1935) and James Cagney (1899). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
